settings.description: App-reported GPS fix itni second se purani ho to bharosa nahi. Sirf tab lagta hai jab app location_timestamp bhejti hai — purane builds achhoote.
Itni baar lagataar bilkul wahi position aane par location frozen maani jayegi. ~10 min (ping interval 60s).
Position itne minute se na badli ho to stale. driver_session_stale_minutes ke barabar.

DEFAULT FALSE — ON karne par dispatch un drivers ko skip karega jinki location bharose ke layak nahi. Aaj OFF hai kyunki 151 ke pool me sirf 5 ka ping taaza hai; ON karne se dispatch baith jayega. Pehle app-side ping coverage theek karo.
Continuous duty itne ghante cross karte hi driver ko soft break alert (socket + push). Ek streak me sirf ek baar.
Continuous duty itne ghante cross karte hi auto-offline. Driver active ride pe ho to defer hota hai — ride khatam hote hi apply.
Duty streak reset karne ke liye minimum offline gap. Isse chhota gap streak carry-forward karta hai (2 min offline hoke clock reset nahi kar sakte).
Break/rest engine ka master switch. FALSE = sessions track hote rahenge par na alert jayega na auto-offline hoga.

settings.description: Master switch — duty session rows likhna. FALSE = koi session record nahi banega (module effectively off). Availability toggle phir bhi normal kaam karega.
Do breadcrumb rows ke beech minimum gap. Isse chhote interval ke pings drop ho jaate hain — write volume control.
Itne din se purane breadcrumb rows retention cron delete kar deta hai.
Breadcrumb trail likhna on/off. FALSE = driver_location_pings me kuch insert nahi hoga (live map phir bhi chalega, wo drivers table se aata hai).
Reaper / break engine / retention jobs ek run me itne rows se zyada nahi chhuenge. Bacha hua kaam agla invocation uthata hai (Lambda timeout safety).

DEFAULT FALSE — product decision: driver ki availability sirf uske apne toggle se badalti hai. App band ho, network gire, phone off ho — drivers.is_available waisa hi rehta hai. TRUE karne par reaper stale drivers ko dispatch se bhi hata dega (active ride phir bhi safe hai, is_on_duty guard ke wajah se).
Itne minute tak location ping na aaye to reaper us duty SESSION ko stale_timeout se band kar deta hai (online-hours sirf zinda time ginein). Driver ki availability isse NAHI badalti.
When false: skip suspension writes + driver:suspended socket emit (FE has socket-disconnect bug)
